# miri by Sol Food — Korean Vegetable Dumplings (U.S. Wholesale & Foodservice)

> miri is the food-specialty brand of Sol Food Co., Ltd., a Korean dumpling (mandu) and udon manufacturer since 1987. HACCP, HALAL and ISO 9001/22000/45001/14001 certified. Now partnering with U.S. importers, distributors, retailers, wholesalers and foodservice operators. Private-label & OEM available.

## Products
- [Vegetable Dumpling](https://miri-b2b-landing.vercel.app/vegetable-dumpling.html): Plant-based Korean mandu made with tofu and vegetables. 560g. Best seller.
- [Kimchi Mandu](https://miri-b2b-landing.vercel.app/product-kimchi.html)
- [Pork Mandu](https://miri-b2b-landing.vercel.app/product-pork.html)
- [Spicy Chili Mandu](https://miri-b2b-landing.vercel.app/product-spicy.html)
- [Shrimp Mandu](https://miri-b2b-landing.vercel.app/product-shrimp.html)
- [Crispy Glass Noodle Mandu](https://miri-b2b-landing.vercel.app/product-glass-noodle.html)
- [Springy Udon Noodle](https://miri-b2b-landing.vercel.app/product-udon.html)
- [All Products](https://miri-b2b-landing.vercel.app/products.html)
